backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing product management with Amazon metadata extraction, user authentication with session management, role-based access control, and blob storage integration for product images.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting console logging additions in ProductManagement component and session token flow verification across useBackendAuth, useQueries, and backend actor calls.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, hooks, and styles, with emphasis on authentication flows, product management, and logging implementations for debugging authorization issues.
frontend/CLOUDFLARE_CDN_SETUP.md: Step-by-step guide for configuring Cloudflare CDN optimizations including auto-minify, Brotli compression, caching rules, image optimization, HTTP/3, and mobile-specific settings to improve site performance.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_TROUBLESHOOTING.md: Deployment troubleshooting guide documenting production failure resolution (missing favicon reference) and comprehensive go-live checklist covering static assets, build verification, service worker registration, and common deployment issues.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point with comprehensive SEO meta tags, Open Graph/Twitter cards, structured data for Kolkata-based fashion e-commerce, and preloaded critical assets (hero banner, logo) for performance.
frontend/PERFORMANCE_ACTION_PLAN.md: Performance optimization action plan targeting 90+ mobile and 95+ desktop Lighthouse scores through JavaScript bundle optimization, image format improvements, render-blocking CSS elimination, and Cloudflare CDN configuration.
frontend/PERFORMANCE_OPTIMIZATION.md: Detailed documentation of implemented performance optimizations including critical path rendering, advanced image optimization with responsive srcset, code splitting with React.lazy, service worker caching strategies, and Core Web Vitals tracking.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Allows all search engine crawlers and references the sitemap.xml location.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: XML sitemap with a single homepage URL entry, last modified 2026-02-17, daily change frequency, and priority 1.0.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets (images, JS, CSS) and network-first for HTML/API, with versioned cache management and special handling for robots.txt/sitemap.xml.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component with lazy-loaded routes (home, products, admin, sitemap), authentication handling, blog modal state, and memoized loading/404 fallback components.
frontend/src/components/admin/BlogManage: A placeholder component that displays a message indicating blog management functionality has been removed from this version.
frontend/src/components/admin/Newsletter: A placeholder component that displays a message indicating newsletter management functionality has been removed from this version.
frontend/src/components/admin/ProductMan: Admin interface for managing products with CRUD operations, supporting fashion and jewellery categories, manual product upload forms, edit dialogs, and delete confirmations with authentication checks.
frontend/src/components/admin/SitePagesM: A placeholder component that displays a message indicating site pages management functionality has been removed from this version.
frontend/src/components/AdminLogin.tsx: Admin authentication modal supporting custom username/password registration/login and Internet Identity, with password strength validation and error handling.
frontend/src/components/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin dashboard with tabbed interface for managing products, blog, newsletter, and site pages, plus logout functionality for both custom auth and Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/AmazonBanner.tsx: Empty component file with no content.
frontend/src/components/BlogPostModal.ts: Dialog modal displaying a message that blog functionality has been removed, with AlertCircle icon and close handler.
frontend/src/components/BlogTeaser.tsx: Memoized component that returns null, effectively hiding the blog teaser section since blog functionality was removed.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with company info (Kolkata-based), quick links, newsletter signup form (disabled), trust badges, social media links, and Amazon Associates disclaimer.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header component with logo, navigation links (Home, Products, Admin), and client-side routing using pushState and popstate events.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero banner section with gradient background, call-to-action buttons for shopping, and trust badges; includes smooth scroll to products section.
frontend/src/components/OptimizedImage.t: Image component with lazy loading via IntersectionObserver, WebP format support with PNG fallback, and responsive srcset generation for performance optimization.
frontend/src/components/PageModal.tsx: Modal component displaying static content for privacy policy, terms of service, and contact pages with close functionality.
frontend/src/components/PasswordStrength: Password strength indicator with visual bar, color-coded strength levels (weak/medium/strong), and validation feedback messages.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Product listing grid with filtering by category and price range, sorting options, and memoized product cards displaying images, prices, discounts, and Amazon affiliate links.
frontend/src/components/SocialProof.tsx: Social proof section displaying customer testimonials with star ratings and a rotating carousel of recent purchases with auto-advance timer.
frontend/src/components/Spinner.tsx: A simple animated SVG spinner component with customizable className that displays a rotating circular loading indicator.
frontend/src/components/TrustBadges.tsx: Displays trust badges (Kolkata-based, Amazon Associates, safe checkout, money-back guarantee, SSL secure) with configurable horizontal or vertical layout and bilingual alt text.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, automatically invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Zustand store with persistence for managing authentication state including session tokens, username, and 24-hour session expiration with automatic cleanup.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendAuth.ts: React Query mutations for user registration, authentication, and logout operations with the backend actor, including error handling and toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useDebounce.ts: Custom hooks providing debounced values and debounced callback functions with configurable delay (default 300ms) for performance optimization.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flows, identity state, and session persistence with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating product data, admin status, and filtering products by category/price. Includes optimized caching with 5-minute stale time and 10-minute cache time.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH color space for light/dark modes, featuring gold and navy theme with WCAG AA+ compliance. Includes custom utilities for card hover effects and price range slider styling.
frontend/src/lib/web-vitals.d.ts: TypeScript type definitions for the web-vitals library, declaring metric types and report handler functions for Core Web Vitals (CLS, FID, FCP, LCP, TTFB).
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient provider for React Query and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, then renders the App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin page component that handles authentication verification (both custom auth and Internet Identity), checks admin status, and conditionally renders AdminLogin or AdminPanel with loading and access denied states.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Simple products listing page with a gradient header section and ProductGrid component to display all fashion, jewellery, and accessories products.
frontend/src/pages/SitemapPage.tsx: Generates and renders a basic XML sitemap dynamically using the canister ID from environment variables, listing homepage and products page with SEO metadata.
frontend/src/utils/delayedScripts.ts: Utility to defer loading of third-party scripts (analytics, chat widgets) until 3 seconds after page load to improve Core Web Vitals and initial render performance.
frontend/src/utils/passwordValidation.ts: Password validation utility that scores password strength (weak/medium/strong) based on length, character types, and provides feedback for missing requirements with minimum 8 characters, lowercase, and number.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: URL parameter parsing utilities that work with both query strings and hash-based routing, including sessionStorage persistence for maintaining state like admin tokens across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file that defines custom color schemes using OKLCH color space (including gold, navy, sidebar, and chart colors), container settings, border radius variables, and imports typography, container queries, and animation plugins.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite build configuration that sets up React, path aliases, environment variables for DFX network and canister IDs, API proxy for local/production ICP hosts, and optimized production builds with code splitting for React, UI libraries, and ICP-specific vendors.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting an authorization bug where users cannot add products despite admin permissions, with pending feature requests to add debug logging and fix the isAdmin check in the backend.
